scope: Current revision final/body AAC, source WAV, encoded premix and known constant BGM numerical integrity; historical source audit applicability only by exact source identity.
executionRequires: Explicit producer completion notification and complete expected final MP4 SHA-256
Completed local final/body/premix and matching default-render/reference receipts
Frozen exact voice-reuse receipt plus all four historical audit copies
requiredNumericalChecks: Actual every-sentence source/premix correlation and gain
Actual final known-source music/voice reconstruction, channel checks and speech-window voice/music level
Actual source coverage, AAC padding, fixed delay and every-sentence drift
Body/final AAC payload, PTS, DTS, duration, size and decoded PCM identity
Retain specifically reviewed source-pause flags; no new encoded quiet interval beyond existing unchanged criteria

dynamicExpectations.bodyFrames: actual SB == words == sum shots == copied source-audit frames
dynamicExpectations.sentenceCount: actual voice/build and sents; expected unchanged 20
dynamicExpectations.frozenInputs: Every exact authorized manifest entry before and after

sourceFlagsPolicy: Historical 5 source / 4 track flags retained, no erased warnings or fresh naturalness judgment.
encodedReusePolicy: Compare previous versus current artifact bytes and record production provenance separately; byte equality alone is not evidence that an artifact was newly generated.
